changelog: fix: review of the first full R re-render (45 figures). (1) UPGMA dendrograms (05_beta_UPGMA, 12_upgma_*) now colour each sample's branch and name by group with a key. 12_upgma used rect.hclust() boxes coloured 'by group', but the boxes are clusters: with Pre-R2 and R2 clustering together, the 'feed' box held a Reactor sample. (2) The same group colour everywhere: group_pal() assigns colours in metadata order, used by the beta heatmaps (05, 17) and dendrograms; 05_beta_heatmap had pheatmap's default green/pink. (3) Taxa detected per sample (22b) no longer counts 'Unclassified' as a taxon. The taxonomy reaching viz_pipeline.R is already cleaned, so every genus without a species added one 'species' (Species 128 > Genus 106 for Pre-R1). (4) No more blank PNGs: a figure that fails half-way is closed and deleted instead of delivered blank, and a device left open by a failed figure is closed before the next one starts drawing into it. The ANCOMBC2 volcano picked the intercept's columns and drew nothing; it now takes the group contrast and skips with a reason when no taxon has both numbers (usual at 2 samples per group). (5) The editor names the figures R skipped or failed, with R's reason, after a render; the full log is kept in edit_charts/r_render.log (17_beta_heatmap_bray was missing from this render and its reason was only in memory). (6) Taxonomy heatmaps are less tall per row. Verified: UPGMA, both heatmaps, the failure clean-up and the species count rendered/tested in R on the U2BI-139 tables; viz_pipeline.R parses; main.py parses; 18 drivers, 592 checks.

previous.changelog: fix: Re-render in R now hands over heatmaps and UPGMA trees, and adds the figures the editor had and R did not; job and results pages keep their actions top-right. (1) Seven figures were drawn by calling pdf() directly rather than through save_pdf(): the Bray-Curtis similarity heatmap, the UPGMA dendrograms (05 and 12), the beta heatmaps (17), the DESeq2 heatmap, and the base-graphics fallbacks for the network and LEfSe cladogram; the taxonomy heatmaps (04b) passed a .pdf filename to pheatmap and the cluster-tree bar figure called ggsave(device='pdf'). A re-render with --device png wrote all of these as PDFs into the PNG folder, where the listing only picks up *.png, so they never reached the download. They now go through open_dev()/save_pdf() and follow the device. (2) New R figures: 02_alpha_all_metrics (every alpha metric, one panel each, by group), 24 prevalence vs abundance (22_prevalence_abundance, one panel per group, prevalence computed within the group), and 22b_species_summary (taxa detected per sample at each rank plus ASVs, rows split by group; lineages counted, not names), with tables prevalence_abundance.csv and species_summary.csv. (3) Beta console: on the job page 'Settings this run used' comes before the pipeline and log, and View results / Download / Delete job (or Cancel job while running) sit top-right beside the job name; on the results page Customise charts and Download everything sit top-right. The delete confirmation opens at the top of the page. Verified: the new figures and open_dev() rendered from the U2BI-139 tables in R (png, pheatmap and base plot); viz_pipeline.R parses; 18 drivers, 590 checks.
